prompt:

Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC neutral thinking-eye atlas
Input images: Image 1 is the exact source reference grid. Preserve this face, neutral brows and original eye anatomy.
Composition: One exact 2×2 pixel-art atlas, full canvas aspect 64:35, each cell 64×35 native pixels. Top-left: image-left gaze, open eyes. Top-right: image-right gaze, open eyes. Bottom-left: image-left gaze, half blink. Bottom-right: image-right gaze, half blink.
Constraints: Keep the source's exact narrow eye aperture, lid contours, brow shape and compact stepped iris/pupil clusters. Preserve the actual source iris hue, skin palette and identity. No wider eyes, broad sclera bands, oversized glints, color changes, vertical/diagonal shifts, makeup, text, borders or added details. Align all four cells exactly.
